statement: MinerU is a broad modern document parser with OCR/VLM and structured-output capabilities overlapping Docling/PaddleOCR.
actakit_implication: Use it as a serious benchmark comparator, not automatically another core framework.

statement: Current MinerU license adds thresholds/attribution beyond plain Apache 2.0.
actakit_implication: Custom license raises maintenance/deployment cost relative to permissive alternatives.

statement: MinerU demonstrates strong specialized document parsing performance.
actakit_implication: Include in external benchmark context even if not selected.

statement: Adopting multiple overlapping structured-document frameworks would increase dependency/model policy complexity.
actakit_implication: Prefer one primary framework plus narrowly justified specialist backends.
